Synthetic test tones for tests/test_backing_track.cpp (decoders off macOS). Generated by us with FFmpeg's lavfi
sine source — no third-party audio:

    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=330:sample_rate=22050:duration=1" -af "volume=2.4" -ac 1 -sample_fmt s16 \
           -metadata title="Test Tone" -metadata artist="Headroom" -compression_level 12 tone330.flac
    ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=330:sample_rate=22050:duration=1" -af "volume=2.4" -ac 1 -c:a libmp3lame \
           -b:a 32k -id3v2_version 3 -metadata title="Test Tone" -metadata artist="Headroom" tone330.mp3

1 s, mono, 22.05 kHz, 330 Hz at peak 0.3. Free to redistribute (CC0).
